recommendations.recommendation: Increase the contrast of secondary grey text (commit messages, 'now' timestamps, 'Manage Topics', counter badges) to at least 4.5:1 against the dark background.
Replace the 'Escape' button label with a descriptive one (e.g. 'Show escaped characters') or add an icon with a visible tooltip/explanation.
Add a visible text label or tooltip to the icon-only compare button next to the branch selector (e.g. 'Compare').
Show absolute dates next to or instead of the relative 'now' (e.g. on the latest commit row) so the last commit time is unambiguous.
Hide developer-oriented footer metrics (Page/Template render time) for regular users.

dimensions.justification: There is little risk of error on this view. The ambiguous 'Escape' button and the bare pencil icon could still be clicked by mistake, but neither is destructive.

dimensions.justification: The task can be done in 1–2 clicks: open docs to reach INSTALL.md, or read the latest commit right on the page. Keyboard shortcuts are shown to support recognition rather than recall.

dimensions.evidence: In dark theme, grey commit-message text such as 'Dodaj src/app.py' and the 'now' timestamps are low-contrast on the dark background. dimensions.justification: Contrast of the main text is fine, but secondary grey text and the badges look close to or below the 4.5:1 ratio WCAG requires for normal text. Icon-only buttons have no visible text label (an accessible name can't be checked from a screenshot), and some targets, such as the pencil icon and badges, are small, though probably at least 24 px. strengths: The latest commit (hash, author, message, time) is shown prominently above the file list, so the 'check last commit' part of the task is answered right away.
Efficient navigation aids: 'Go to file' with a 'T' shortcut, code search with an 'S' shortcut, and a branch selector, all near the file tree.
Consistent, GitHub-like layout: tabs with counters, a clearly marked active 'Code' tab, and a breadcrumb title.

recommendations.recommendation: Make the grey secondary text (commit messages, 'now' timestamps, counter badges) lighter in dark theme so it reaches at least 4.5:1 contrast. Make sure the icon-only buttons (RSS, compare, pencil) have visible tooltips and accessible names.

Rename the 'Escape' button in the README header to something descriptive, such as 'Escape ambiguous characters' or 'Show hidden Unicode', or add an explanatory tooltip so it isn't read as a close/cancel action.
Show the absolute commit date next to (or instead of) the relative 'now' in the latest-commit row, so users can check exactly when the last commit was made.
Remove the duplicate Stars/Watchers/Forks counters from the sidebar (they are already in the header buttons). Hide the developer timing info ('Page: 20ms Template: 5ms') from regular users.

dimensions.justification: Main text contrast looks fine, but the grey secondary text and the small shortcut badges may fall near or below the 4.5:1 ratio WCAG 1.4.3 requires. strengths: The latest-commit row and the per-file last-commit messages are visible right away, so the 'check the latest commit' task needs almost no navigation.
'Go to file' and 'Search code…' have visible keyboard shortcut hints (T, S), which make finding files like docs/INSTALL.md efficient.
The layout follows Git platform conventions (tab bar with counters, branch selector, Star/Fork/Watch buttons), and the Code tab is clearly marked as active.

recommendations.recommendation: Make the grey secondary text lighter (timestamps, commit messages in the file table, 'Manage Topics', footer) and the shortcut badges ('T', 'S') too, so they reach at least 4.5:1 contrast against the dark background.
Rename the 'Escape' button in the README header to something descriptive, such as 'Show escaped characters', or hide it when the file has no ambiguous characters.

Show an absolute date or tooltip next to relative times like 'now', and make the latest-commit row look different from the file rows (e.g. a tinted header background) so it reads as the repo's latest commit.
Add visible text labels or accessible names to the icon-only buttons (compare button next to the branch selector, README edit pencil, RSS) and make sure their targets are at least 24×24 px.
Hide repo tabs for features that aren't used (Packages, Projects, Wiki, Actions) or collapse them under a 'More' menu to cut navigation noise.
